name: Board
description: Agent-defined interactive information boards with isolated custom content.
mainDocument: Read and compose conversation information Boards. Optional instanceKey addresses independent documents; omitted or default selects the legacy Board at its unchanged storage address. Use short document/block/event IDs; these are authored content, not storage addresses. Removing an information-panel placement never deletes its Board body. read returns an exact contentSnapshot, including revision 0 for absence without creating state. Read view:document for the complete authored body before replacing it. Native put requires expectedRevision from that read; model callers use the opaque snapshot supplied by the model facade. put compares body revision inside the existing serial owner checks, preserves latest user field values, and returns applied:false on conflict without writing or cancelling an existing interaction. Conflicts require a fresh complete read and deliberate reconsideration; unknown outcomes are checked by reading the same owner and instanceKey, never automatic retry or bypassing a storage fence. User draft values are unsent, never approval. Templates (notes, metrics, progress, fields, actions) compose freely with custom isolated HTML/CSS/JS. UI events alone may deliver assembled text or execute scripts; model tools cannot invoke human events. Submit text interpolates {{field}}. Scripts use only {{valuesBase64}} (base64 JSON of fields) so user input is not shell code. if conditions may inspect result.exitCode/result.output after a script. Owner defaults to the calling Thread; explicit Room owner must use that exact member Thread. No model message is sent merely by updating or reading a Board.

permissions.title: Manage information boards
permissions.description: Read and update conversation-owned Board documents; explicit user events use existing Host permissions.

tools.name: zenx_board_put
tools.description: Replace exactly the addressed Board body only when expectedRevision matches the observed contentSnapshot revision. Preserve latest user draft values and pin state. A conflict returns applied:false with current semantic state and performs no write or interaction cancellation; read the complete document before reconsidering. Unknown outcomes must be checked by read, never retried automatically. No model delivery or execution occurs.

instanceKey.description: Independent Board address, separate from document.id and execution owner; omitted/default preserves the legacy Board.

tools.name: zenx_board_read
tools.description: Read compact semantic Board state by default, or view:document for the full authored body, events, HTML and unsent drafts. Returns an exact owner/body-revision contentSnapshot, including known absence at revision 0 without writing state. Only a complete requested view or absence supports whole-body replacement in the model facade; inspect full-content output spools. A snapshot is version/view evidence, not approval or proof of comprehension.

instanceKey.description: Independent Board address, separate from document.id and execution owner; omitted/default preserves the legacy Board.

tools.name: zenx_board_ui
tools.description: Human UI only; unavailable to models.
